name: ashakids-platform
description: ASHAKids Platform - Modular Architecture for Frontend & Backend

scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix backend run build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/e2e/e2e_full_flow.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
